instruction: Determine each sales rep's average sales across all months and record this value in a new 'Average' column.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating average sales per rep across 6 months for ALL sales reps. Evaluator verifies: 1) Column H has header 'Average', 2) All 5+ sales reps have calculated averages, 3) Average values are mathematically correct. First rep (Ivelisse Peel) total=2894, average=2894/6=482.33. Custom getter extracts header and all average values from column H. Metric checks header match (20% weight), row count >=5 (20% weight), and validates each average with partial credit (60% weight), using 0.5 tolerance for rounding.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks ALL requirements - column header 'Average', all sales rep averages, and row count validation.
Correct getter logic: Getter extracts header from H1 and ALL average values from column H starting at row 2, iterating until empty cell (xlsx.py:46-71).
Correct metric logic: Metric validates header (20% weight), row count >=5 (20% weight), and ALL average values with partial credit (60% weight) (xlsx.py:36-78).
Proper partial credit: Metric awards proportional score based on number of correct averages (correct_count / total_expected), ensuring all 5 sales reps must have correct averages for full score.
Mathematically correct expected values: Expected averages [482.33, 480.17, 475.67, 481.00, 479.83] are verified in metadata explanation as correct (first rep: 2894/6=482.33).
Appropriate tolerance: Uses 0.5 tolerance for floating-point comparison, suitable for rounding differences in average calculations.
Proper postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure formulas are evaluated before reading values.
